author: kroening
body:
## Changes

`restrictt::RES` (the implementation behind `restrict`, and hence `exists`
and `substitute`) recursed over the BDD without a computed table. A BDD is a
DAG whose sub-graphs are shared, so a plain recursion revisits shared
sub-graphs repeatedly, which is exponential in the worst case.

This adds a per-call computed table (memoisation), mirroring the existing
`mini_bdd_applyt::G` table used by `apply`. The cache is keyed on the node
number; `var` and `value` are fixed for a given `restrictt` instance, so the
node number alone is a correct key. The cache lives only for the duration of
a single `restrict` call, which avoids any invalidation concerns when node
numbers are recycled by `remove_reference()`.

## Motivation

This is the follow-up improvement noted at the end of
diffblue/hw-cbmc#1801: with early variable quantification in place, the
remaining gap to CUDD-based tools is dominated by the unmemoised miniBDD
`restrict`/`exists`. The backward `EX` fixed point used by the `ebmc --bdd`
model checker applies `restrict`/`exists` repeatedly to large BDDs, so the
missing computed table hurts there most.

## Performance

Measured with `ebmc --bdd` on HWMCC08 AIGER benchmarks, **on top of**
diffblue/hw-cbmc#1801 (early variable quantification). Two builds that differ
only by this commit in the cbmc submodule:

* baseline: hw-cbmc `kroening/early-variable-quantification`, unmodified cbmc
* patched: same, plus this commit

50 smallest instances (by file size) with an ABC reference answer, 20s
timeout per instance, Apple Silicon.

| | Baseline | Patched |
|---|---|---|
| Solved | 29 | 30 |
| Time on the 29 solved by both | 24.04s | 22.02s (1.09×) |
| Answers disagreeing with ABC reference | 0 | 0 |

All answers from both builds agree with the ABC reference column in
`hwmcc08results.csv`. The patched build additionally solves
`nusmvsyncarb10p2` (baseline times out at 20s; patched finishes in 6.9s);
the baseline solves nothing the patched build misses. Representative
per-instance wins among those solved by both:

| Instance | Baseline | Patched |
|---|---|---|
| pdtvistwo0 | 1.15s | 0.15s |
| visarbiter | 5.36s | 4.85s |
| pdtvisminmax2 | 4.04s | 3.68s |
| ringp0 | 1.66s | 1.50s |

## Testing

`unit "[miniBDD]"` and `unit "[solver]"` pass. The change preserves the
semantics of `restrict`; the HWMCC08 cross-check against the ABC reference
answers shows no regressions in correctness.

author: sarthak20241
body:
## Problem
With the food box focused, tapping a bookmark opened its sheet behind the keyboard:
- Header bookmark → **Saved** sheet: bottom hidden under the keyboard.
- Waiting meal card bookmark → **Save for next time** sheet: same.

The nutrition ScrollView uses `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"`, so the tap never blurs the food box. `SaveMealSheet` lifts itself only on a keyboard *show* event, and none fires for a keyboard that is already up. `SavedMealsSheet` has no keyboard handling at all.

## Fix
Both sheets call `Keyboard.dismiss()` when they open. Neither needs the food box keyboard: the saved list takes no typing, and the save sheet's name is prefilled. Tapping the name field still raises the keyboard and the sheet lifts above it as before.

## Tested (iOS sim, signed in, this branch's bundle on its own Metro)
- [x] Food box focused + header bookmark → keyboard drops, Saved sheet fully visible
- [x] Food box focused + meal card bookmark → keyboard drops, Save sheet fully visible
- [x] Tap the Name field in the Save sheet → sheet sits above the keyboard
- [ ] Android not tested

App code only, no edge functions: no deploy label needed. Ships via OTA.

body:
## What

Fix for issue #6344, needed for R65 (the old machine's R65 request, which the owner approved on 2026-10-12: 「按建议执行」).

On the demo machine (R64), the attendance admin center throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'trim')` from `formatUserLabel`. The cause: email is optional when a user is created, so the user search returns `null` for it, and `apps/web/src/views/attendance/useAttendanceAdminUsers.ts:59-60` called `.trim()` on it. These lines have been unchanged since R62. The bug only showed up once the demo machine had a user without an email.

- **Loader:** a non-string `email` is now normalised to `''` when users are loaded, so every consumer of `users` sees a string, matching the declared type.
- **`formatUserLabel`:** now null-safe on its own. The primary part is the name, else the email, else the id. The secondary part is the email if it differs from the primary, else the id if that differs, else nothing (no more `id · id`). Labels for users with an email are unchanged (`Alice · alice@example.com`).
- **Approval directory:** the issue also asked about `apps/web/src/approvals/useApprovalDirectory.ts:260-261`. That code is not affected, because `asUserOptions` (`:77-78`) already turns a non-string name or email into `''`.

## Verify

- `apps/web`: `npx vitest run tests/useAttendanceAdminUsers.spec.ts` gives 6/6. The new case covers a user with no email but a name (`Bob · user-2`), no email and no name (`user-3`), an email with an employee number (`carol@example.com · E4 · user-4`), and the formatter called directly with `email: null` (`Dan · user-5`).
- With the source change reverted and the new spec kept, that case goes red. With the fix restored it is green again.

Values-free.

_Requested by **Erik** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KzG9voPzhAGxpxt4doP1QN?thread=cmsg_01KzG9voPzhAGxpxt4doP1QNC6p8hM5f9ebFcbPcwpzSvo)_

Before: during a rolling control-plane redeploy, the first updated machine applied CoreDNS and metrics-server with the new image tag. The new pods could then land on a control-plane node that hadn't seeded that image yet and fail with `ErrImageNeverPull`.

After: each machine that seeds an addon image labels its node `cairn/<addon>-image=<tag>` through inoculant. The Deployments require that label alongside the hostname, so new pods only schedule where the image exists.

How: a new `modules/service/seeded-image.nix` holds the label name and builds the node affinity. Both addons' control-plane roles set the label through inoculant's `nodeLabels` when the kubelet runs on the machine. `checks/addon-manifests.nix` asserts the label term in the affinity. This also removes the "redeploy every control-plane machine together" caveat from #115.

Closes #103

Closes #5257 - Trade rows show only their time, on the account cards' clock (`10:31 AM ET`). Closes #5104 - Milestone, filing and merge rows drop the date their meta repeated (`+25 pts · 9/30/2026` → `+25 pts`). - Review live after deploy: /app/activity
Why, acceptance & the weeds ### Why Eric picked option A on #5161's round 2: "I like the divider, day of week and month". The divider states the day once, so each row stops repeating it. ### Acceptance criteria (EARS) - WHEN the feed shows events, each New York day SHALL open with one centred divider — verified: `activity-days.spec.tsx` "starts each day with one divider…" - A fill at 23:30 ET Oct 5 (03:30 UTC Oct 6) SHALL file under `MON · OCT 5` — verified: "files a fill at 23:30 ET…" - A trade row's time SHALL equal the account card's `orderTime` — verified: `wire-trade-row.spec.tsx` "shows the fill's time as the account card's clock writes it" - WHEN "Load older trades" appends a page that starts mid-day, that day SHALL keep one divider — verified: "continues a day under its existing divider…" - WHEN a filter empties a day, its divider SHALL not render — verified: "draws no divider for a day the filter left empty" - Dividers SHALL stay out of the event count a screen reader hears — verified: "keeps the dividers out of the feed's event count" (each is an `h3`, as `activity-cards.tsx` does) - Milestone, filing and merge meta SHALL drop the date — verified: `wire-json-view.spec.ts`, `wire-milestone-row.spec.tsx` ### What changed - `app/src/shell/activity-days.tsx` (new): groups the filtered, paged list with `byDay` and draws one heading per day with `dayHeader`. Both come from `order-facts.ts`, so the feed and the account cards write days the same way. - `app/src/routes/activity.tsx`: the feed's `
    ` becomes ``. The row choice is unchanged. - `app/src/shell/wire-trade-row.tsx`: the time comes from `orderTime({ at })`. A server too old to send `at` falls back to its own `when`. - `src/observatory/wire-json-view.ts`: the meta is `#701`, `#4273` or `+25 pts`. An earn the course score doesn't count now has an empty meta, and the row draws nothing for it. - `app/src/styles/activity-feed.css`: `.wire-day-head` is a flex row with a `--border` line on each side and equal space above and below. The text uses the cards' header type in `--muted`. - `docs/PATTERNS.md`: three rows banked beside *Day headers over a history*: the centred divider is placed, the date column is declined, and "new since your last look" is declined. - `scripts/shoot/activity.mjs`: stub fills now span five market days, the meta has no date, and one frame shows a day boundary. ### Design notes & trade-offs - **Assumption:** a feed with only one day still gets its divider. The EARS line says "more than one day", but the rows no longer carry a date, so without a divider a one-day feed would show no date anywhere. - The divider's line is decoration. The words carry the day, and `--muted` already holds AA in both themes (the cards use the same token). - Only the date, the time and the grouping changed. The rest of the trade row belongs to #5101's redesign. - Measured cost, which Eric saw and kept: fewer events fit on the first screen (#5161 r2: 4 on the phone, 7 on desktop). ### Verification - [x] `npm run typecheck` (root + app) - [x] `npm run lint` - [x] `npm test` (root) and `npm run test:app` - [x] Screenshot / visual check: frames above ### Risk & rollback - Presentation only, plus one server string format that only this feed reads. Revert the squash commit to back it out. ### Follow-ups - None. #5104 closes with this.

author: institutoevanutro-dev
body:
## O que muda para quem usa

`PATCH /api/v1/ai/agents/{id}/versions/{vid}` com um campo só gravava o valor padrão em tudo o que não veio no corpo. Medido em produção em 2026-10-11: um PATCH com `{ system_prompt }` num rascunho zerou `tool_ids`, desligou `cases_enabled`, `split_messages` e `followup`, e devolveu `max_steps`, `split_max_chars` e `handoff_keywords` ao padrão. O rascunho foi publicado e o agente ficou sem ferramenta (dizia que marcou consulta sem marcar).

Agora só o que vem no corpo é gravado.

## Causa

`versionPatchSchema` era `versionShapeSchema.partial()`, e no Zod `.partial()` preserva `.default(...)`: campo omitido sai do parse com o default, e `patch.x !== undefined` é verdadeiro para todos eles. Efeito colateral da mesma causa: corpo `{}` passava da guarda "Body vazio" e zerava o rascunho com 200.

## Conserto

- `lib/ai/agents/validation.ts`: `parseVersionPatch(raw)` valida com o schema parcial e devolve só as chaves presentes no corpo bruto. O schema parcial deixou de ser exportado, para ninguém reusar a armadilha.
- Rota: usa `parseVersionPatch` e grava o patch inteiro (o schema é `.strict()`).
- Server action do editor (`saveAgentDraftAction`): mesma função.

### Mudança além do pedido, na mesma rota (revisar)

A cópia campo a campo da rota não incluía `operator_enabled`, `operator_model`, `operator_tool_ids`, `pipeline_ids` e `knowledge_source_ids`: o schema aceitava, a rota respondia 200 e não gravava. Agora grava, e `pipeline_ids`/`knowledge_source_ids` passam por `validarEscopoDaVersao`, como o POST de versões já faz. Se preferirem isso em PR separado, eu tiro.

## A tela

O editor não chama a rota REST; usa `saveAgentDraftAction`, que valida o payload com `versionCreateSchema` (objeto inteiro) antes do parse parcial. Todas as chaves estão presentes, então o filtro não remove nada e o caminho da tela não muda. Por isso o defeito nunca apareceu pela tela.

## Outros `.partial()`

`agentMcpPatchSchema` não é `.partial()` e não tem default nos campos opcionais: sem o defeito. Era o único `.partial()` do arquivo.

## O que medi

- Teste novo `app/api/v1/ai/agents/[id]/versions/[vid]/route.test.ts`: vermelho antes do conserto (3 de 3 na primeira versão), verde depois (4 de 4).
- Sabotagem (devolver o parse sem filtrar): 4 vermelhos de 4, o previsto. Restaurado.
- `pnpm typecheck` exit 0, `pnpm lint` 0 erros, `pnpm lint:channels` exit 0.
- `pnpm test:unit` completo, já com a `main` 3.23.0 mesclada: exit 0, `Test Files 1431 passed (1431)`, `Tests 14490 passed | 1 expected fail (14491)`, sem linha `Errors`.
- `pnpm release:conferir` aceita o fragmento; pré-voo do contribuidor sem alerta.

## O que NÃO medi

- `pnpm test:db`, `pnpm test:e2e` e `pnpm build`: não rodei (sem mudança de schema nem de tela).
- Prova pela tela: não fiz; o caminho da tela foi conferido por leitura do código, não dirigindo o navegador.
- A rota contra um banco real: o teste usa um stub do cliente admin.
- Outros `.partial()` do repositório (`lib/schemas/routing.ts`, `contacts.ts`, `produtos.ts`, `webhooks.ts`, `templates.ts`, `lib/ai/guardrails-schema.ts`, `lib/ai/decisao/config.ts`, `app/api/v1/agenda/{unidades,tipos}`): os schemas de criação deles têm `.default(...)`, então podem ter o mesmo defeito. Não verifiquei nenhum.

author: frankbria
body:
## Summary

Implements #106: the two checks `cli.py` still made for itself are the engine's.

Every decision a front end needs is meant to come from the engine, so a GUI doesn't copy it. Two small ones were still in `src/lecture_forge/cli.py`.

- **May a plan be written here?** `plan.check_new_plan(path, force)` is the guard `plan.write_plan` already had, under a name of its own. `cli.cmd_plan` calls it before the planning call and has no existence test of its own; `write_plan` calls it too, as its last line of defence.
- **Can this series continue that one?** `plan.check_continues(root, series, other)`: `other` must be a valid series name, not `series` itself, and have a `plan.yaml`. `cli._continues` calls it; `cli.py` no longer uses `plan.SLUG` or looks for the file.
- **The CLI's lines are what they were.** The first error already named its remedy (`fix` `replace_plan`), which the CLI words with `--force`. For the second, the engine says `a series can only continue another series that has a plan.yaml, got 'x'`, and the CLI says the same rule (`plan.CONTINUES_RULE`) of its flag: `--continues must name another series that has a plan.yaml, got 'x'`, as it does for the series name.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] An engine function answers "may a plan be written here?" before any LLM call. `cli.cmd_plan` calls it and has no `out.exists()` test of its own. The CLI's line is unchanged.
- [x] An engine function answers "can this series continue that one?". `cli._continues` calls it and no longer uses `plan.SLUG` or looks for the file. The CLI's line is unchanged.
- [x] The engine's messages name no flag (`tests/test_errors.py` scans every engine string).
- [x] An engine-level test for each; the existing CLI tests (`test_continues_must_be_another_planned_series_before_any_llm_call`, the `plan` refusal tests) pass unchanged.
- [x] `uv run pytest -m "not integration" --cov --cov-fail-under=85` and ruff pass.

## Test plan

- [x] Tests written first (TDD); 514 pass with `-m "not integration"`, coverage 97%
- [x] Diff coverage 100% on the changed source lines
- [x] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean
- [x] Mutation check: 14 of 14 mutants killed, run on the final code
- [x] Internal code review (advisory): no Critical or Major finding
- [x] Cross-family review before the PR: codex (no findings) and Kimi (APPROVE, one nitpick with no action), on `c358c74`. opencode's GLM plan is out of quota until tomorrow, so Kimi takes its place, through the same tool.
- [x] Cross-family review on the PR: codex (the whole diff, no findings) and Kimi (the change since its approval, APPROVE) on `e9fb129`, posted as a comment with the triage
- [x] Demo: each criterion through the real `plan` command with a stand-in model, main next to the branch, and the two engine functions asked directly (posted as a comment)
- [x] Deslop scan: nothing found

No existing test's expectation changed.

### Review findings before the PR

- Fixed (mutation pass): no test showed that an existing plan is refused before a model call is spent, which is what the first criterion is about. `test_plan_refuses_an_existing_plan_before_any_llm_call` asserts the line and that the refusal cost nothing. It passes on main as well: it pins behaviour that had no test.
- Fixed (internal, nitpick): the two new engine tests imported inside the function; they import with the rest of the module.
- Skipped (Kimi, nitpick): the CLI builds its line from the engine's `CONTINUES_RULE`, so rewording the rule changes the CLI's line. That is the point, as with `SLUG_RULE`, and a CLI test pins the whole line.
- Skipped (internal, nitpick): `Path(path)` in `check_new_plan` is redundant for a caller that passes a `Path`. It costs nothing and takes a string too.

## Known limitations / intentionally deferred

- **What "can series A continue series B?" means is still two engine calls**: `plan.check_continues` (a name, and a plan there) and `write.continued_recap` (that plan loads; whether its last episode is written). The first must hold before planning; the second is only a note at that point. A front end calls both, as `cli.cmd_plan` does.
- **`render` and `run` were not run by hand** (the agent can't). `run` reaches both checks through the same functions, and `tests/test_run.py` covers it.

## Implementation notes

- The plan is the issue's definition of done; the agent's version of it is on the issue.

Closes #106

author: jlobue10
body:
USB/Bluetooth driver callbacks checked `stopped` only before looking up their context. A callback already inside state, motion, touch or battery forwarding could remain in flight while `stop()` returned, allowing its eventual JNI send to reach a replacement process-wide native session. Controller removal could likewise send the release before an already-admitted callback finished.

All four driver callbacks now hold the existing `controllerMaskLock` from admission through the send. Stop and removal share that gate, so admitted callbacks finish before retirement and later callbacks are suppressed. The existing motion-rate lock remains nested only for rate accounting, with no new device or USB I/O inside the gate.

This also advances the common-C submodule to jlobue10/moonlight-common-c#39 (`cc771306ca6f03b9101c1139a099cec623515e4b`) so the companion sticky mouse-edge fix is included in Android.

Validation:
- Expanded production lifecycle/native-forwarding harness: 20 of 55 checks fail on the original code; all 55 pass after the fix.
- Covers live and late events plus deterministic pauses at the native boundary for state, motion, touch and battery, racing both stop and removal.
- Arrival replay, motion decimation, and driver-event harnesses pass after updating their fixture lock declarations.
- All 41 Android regression scripts passed across baseline and affected-test reruns. JNI headers and the pinned native submodule were loaded for the native fixtures; ASan/UBSan checks ran with leak scanning disabled under ptrace.
- Physical Steam Controller puck/Bluetooth sessions and a full Android build were not run locally; CI remains required.

Audit 27, non-Daybreak finding A27-01 (medium). Merge common-C #39 before this PR. No release or version bump.

author: spacedragon
body:
## Summary

Bundles an S3-compatible object store, [RustFS](https://rustfs.com), into the full Docker Compose stack and the Helm chart, and turns on the features that use it.

- **Setup script:** `charts/agentconnect/files/object-store-setup.sh` is shared by Compose and the chart, and is safe to rerun. It runs in the upstream `rustfs/rustfs` image and uses its `curl --aws-sigv4`, so no extra client or custom image is needed. It:
  - creates the bucket
  - applies the `pending`/`unreferenced` lifecycle rules under `<prefix>/src/`
  - sets a bucket CORS rule that admits only the console origin
- **Compose (`compose.logto.https.yaml`):** adds `object-store` and `object-store-setup`, plus a Caddy `tls internal` site on `AGENTCONNECT_OBJECT_STORE_HTTPS_PORT`. Sets `AC_FILE_TRANSFER` on the Control Plane, so console file transfer is on.
  - A `caddy-ca` one-shot copies only Caddy's root certificate, mode 0644, into its own volume. The Control Plane trusts it through `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`.
  - Caddy now starts first. Its routes answer 502 until upstreams are healthy.
  - Compose runs no pool members, so the Source Cache for bundles does not apply there.
- **Chart:** a new `sourceCache.store` block (on by default) does nothing until `sourceCache.store.host` is set. Once set, it renders:
  - a RustFS StatefulSet with a PVC
  - a generated key-pair Secret, reused on upgrade
  - a post-install/post-upgrade setup Job
  - an HTTPRoute that gives the store its `https://` origin

  Members get `AC_SOURCE_CACHE` and the Control Plane gets `AC_FILE_TRANSFER`, both reading the Secret as mounted files. `publicUrl` is required for CORS. `sourceCache.enabled: true` (an external bucket) still takes precedence, unchanged.
- **Docs:** chart README "Bundled store" / "External bucket"; `docs/self-host-caddy-https.md` gains the new variables and an object store section.

### Trade-off

RustFS has no simple way to create a narrower user, so members and the Control Plane use the store's root keys. The store holds only this release's cache and transfers.

## Testing

- Ran the existing `test/source-cache-minio.int.test.ts` against RustFS 1.0.1: 9/9 pass, after relaxing one MinIO-specific detail in a local copy. An omitted signed `x-amz-tagging` header is refused with 403 `SignatureDoesNotMatch` instead of MinIO's 400 `AccessDenied`. Coverage includes:
  - signed length, checksum and tag enforcement
  - expired GET
  - full write-back
  - sweep
  - the lifecycle gate
- Compose (store, setup and Caddy on spare ports) driven by the Control Plane's real file-transfer code:
  - the lifecycle gate reads `present`
  - the CORS preflight from the console origin returns 200 with that origin; other origins are refused
  - the signed PUT and GET through Caddy both return 200
  - setup reruns cleanly
  - a non-root Node process trusting only the copied root reaches the store
- `ruby scripts/test-chart-render.rb` passes with bundled-store assertions, including that the ConfigMap carries the shared script verbatim. `helm lint` and `docker compose config` pass.
- Not tested: the whole stack with Logto, and a real cluster install.

Follow-up worth considering: CI still runs the presigned-URL suite against MinIO only. Teaching its global setup to target an external endpoint would let it cover the bundled RustFS too.

author: ac1982
body:
`add_rows()` documents support for row iterators, but on Python 3 its default `header=True` path attempts to subscript a generator or list iterator:

```python
Texttable().add_rows(iter([["Name"], ["Alice"]]))
# TypeError: 'list_iterator' object is not subscriptable
```

Recognize the Python 3 `__next__` protocol and consume the header with `next()`. Preserve the existing Python 2 iterator and sequence paths. Tests compare generator/list-iterator output against list input with and without a header, and cover a header-only iterator.

Three new cases fail before the fix; all 20 tests pass afterward with the tox-prescribed coverage command and cjkwrap installed. `git diff --check` passes. Tested on Linux/arm64, Python 3.14.4; Python 2 was not available locally.

This restores the documented input behavior. It does not implement the streaming-output API proposed in #59; rows are still stored and rendered as before.

Developed and verified with AI assistance.

author: markleit
body:
Part of #204. Found on the 2.2 (3) device pass (Feedback #232). The phone was offline with ten photos and a voice message queued, then locked; airplane mode was turned off. Nothing went until the app was opened 8 minutes later.

## What the send log showed
- **02:00:52:** every message logged `offline: handing to iOS`, but none logged `submit bg` until **02:08:51**.
- **The token:** it had under 10 minutes left, so each hand-over refreshed it first. Offline, that refresh waits for the network.
- **The lock:** at 02:00:57 the phone locked. Leaving the foreground only covered queued and waiting messages, not ones already under way, so it didn't keep the app awake, and the app was suspended mid-wait.
- On 2.2 (2) the token was fresh, so the refresh never happened.

## Fix
1. **`SendPolicy.tokenChoice`:** offline, the stored token goes at once, expired or not. A refresh happens first only when there's a network. If the server later refuses the token, that 401 wakes the app.
2. **Leaving the foreground** waits for every hand-over still on its way to iOS (getting a token or upload link). New `SendEngine.whenHandedOver`.
3. **Background wake (M9):** the app reports the wake handled to iOS (which may then suspend it) only once nothing is on its way to iOS. A 401 refreshes and hands the message back first.

## Tests (written from the requirement; each fails with its part undone)
- `testW3LeavingTheAppWaitsForAHandOverStillGettingItsToken`
- `testOfflineTheStoredTokenGoesAtOnceEvenIfExpired`, plus two other `tokenChoice` tests
- `testM9AfterA401WhileSuspendedTheWakeLastsUntilTheMessageIsBackWithIOS`
- Send suites locally: 76/76.

`docs/SEND_REQUIREMENTS.md`: rows W3, R11 and R7 updated.

## Device (2.2 (4))
- **M5 again:** airplane mode on, send 10 photos and a voice message, lock, airplane mode off. They should arrive before you unlock.
- **M9 (optional):** the same, but leave airplane mode on for more than an hour first, so the token expires.

body:
## What

Closes the remaining allowed forms of a write to a pre-existing link that resolves to `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, for Claude Code and Codex, per-user and managed. Includes the GAP-1556 fix (03b90c9d6, resolves managed write operands through linked paths) as the first commit, based on main.

- #1168 shell variables and parameter expansions: bounded same-command assignments and literal `${x:-lit}` defaults get an operand fact on the hook client (Resolve) and the same candidate values in the gateway proof. A variable assigned in a conditional, loop, pipeline, function, command substitution, or by an unmodelled builtin (eval, source, export, declare, read, printf -v, `+=`, ...) is unresolvable and fails closed.
- #1169 interpreter literal writes: Python `Path.open`, Python stdin bodies (here-doc, here-string, echo/printf/cat pipelines), Perl lexical `open my $fh`, Node `createWriteStream`, and `env -C` children.
- #1170 multicall applets after `cd` (busybox tee and the other unwrapped applets), `tar -C dirlink` with an explicit member, `ln` destinations through a linked directory.
- #1171 directory walker: function bodies run with the call-site directory, coproc bodies use a cloned state; redirects are matched to the safe-redirect list by source position instead of by index.
- #1167 (GAP-1548 form 4): `cp --archive` / `cp -a` of an existing link under ProtectHome-style managed mode, rows added to `TestManagedWriteOperandFactsForRelativeLinkHop`.
- GAP-1569 / #1175 compound cd rows are in the blocked table and already passed.

## Why

Edge-case bypass hunt (issues #1167 to #1171, parent #1096). Policy: fail closed on anything the proof cannot resolve statically, but ordinary commands stay allowed. A regression found in review while building this (redirects nested in if/for/case/function bodies and substitutions were no longer visible to the operand extractors, and wrong-value variable tracking) is fixed and covered by a table test.

## Tests

- New table of 137 ordinary commands that must stay allowed in all four modes (`TestCommandLinkWriteFailsClosedInEveryMode`); 16 bypass rows fail before and pass after.
- `TestShellWriteOperandsNestedAndPoisonedVariables`, `TestShellExtraWriteOperandsTarMembers` in `internal/hookpaths`.
- Run on the build box: gofmt (Go 1.26), build and vet for linux, darwin and windows, `go test` for `internal/hookpaths`, `internal/enterprisehooks/...`, `internal/actionfacts/...`, all of `internal/gateway/...`; Windows test compile for `internal/hookpaths` and `internal/gateway`.

## Not in this PR

False blocks in #1174 (GAP-1557, GAP-1558, GAP-1523, GAP-1369, GAP-1525 and related) are left for a second PR so no block is weakened here.

## Still to do

- Windows `dcw-preflight` real-test run (no free preflight host at the time; needs a clone).
- Live verification before the gaps move past fixed-needs-verify: managed Linux, per-user Linux, managed Windows, with the neutral permission-check rows on real hosts.
- Codex run note: the dev host login did not accept the default model, so the implementation pass used gpt-5.5 at xhigh effort; the diff was reviewed independently.

author: ryannzz2205
body:
## Summary

- Add the user-facing `sort FIELD [ORDER]` command.
- Default omitted ORDER values to ascending order.
- Validate fields and directions case-insensitively with exact error messages.
- Sort only the currently displayed contacts without changing stored order or filtered membership.

## Supported values

- Fields: `name`, `phone`, `email`, `address`, and `tag`
- Directions: `asc` and `desc`

## Comparison rules

- Compare names, emails, and addresses case-insensitively using the complete value.
- Compare phone numbers numerically, ignoring leading zeroes.
- Use the alphabetically first tag as the primary tag and keep untagged contacts last.
- Break primary-value ties by name ascending and preserve the displayed order for complete ties.

## Tests performed

- Parser, command, and model test suites
- Full Gradle test suite
- `checkstyleMain` and `checkstyleTest`

All tests and checks pass.

## Known limitations

- Sorting is not persisted between application sessions.
- Only one user-selected sort field is supported.
- Text comparison is not locale-aware.
- Running `list` or a new `find` clears the displayed sort.

Closes issue #53

Owner ask: stop pinging every chat with the same text. Read it first: what is the action, did it finish, is it blocked on me?

Before an automatic nudge (merge-ready, ci-finished, status-check, idle-report, bb3-slow-agent, and resume except after a limit or error), a model reads the chat. That means its facts, the agent's full last message, and the last 3 nudges. It then decides one of three:
- **send**: one short message about what's actually missing. Nothing generic.
- **wait**: the agent already answered, or is blocked on something passive (a queued run, a reviewer, CI, a limit).
- **ask-owner**: a concrete question, using the agent's own options.

How it runs:
- Model: GPT-6.1 Sol through the owner's codex-lb, the owner's choice. It is called via `codex exec --ephemeral -s read-only --output-schema`, with its own minimal Codex home: only the provider, no MCP servers or hooks.
- Output is schema-checked and clamped.
- If the model fails, the supervisor waits. It never sends blind.
- At most 6 calls per scan, 3 at a time, 40 s each, 60 s in total.
- Verdicts are cached for 2 h by chat state, so an unchanged chat is not re-judged.
- Owner answers, owner messages, escalations and limit resumes are never judged.
- Off by default: `OPENAGI_FLEET_JUDGE=1` plus `OPENAGI_FLEET_JUDGE_MODEL=gpt-6.1-sol`.

Live call check, with no agent messaged: "Blocked on: your decision" → ask-owner; "Blocked on: the queued full run and a reviewer" → wait. About 9 s each.

Stacked on #170. `npm test` passes.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes Auto-mode agent messaging when enabled, but it is off by default, failures never send blindly, and the judge runs read-only with minimal Codex config; mis-verdicts could still delay or mis-route nudges.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds an **optional nudge judge** so Auto mode does not blast the same templated message into every thread. When `OPENAGI_FLEET_JUDGE=1` and `OPENAGI_FLEET_JUDGE_MODEL` are set, the supervisor runs a read-only `codex exec` call (via codex-lb) **before** selected automatic nudges (`merge-ready`, `ci-finished`, `status-check`, `idle-report`, `bb3-slow-agent`, and most `resume` cases).
> 
> The model returns **send** (short custom text), **wait**, or **ask-owner** (raises a `judge:` question relayed like other agent asks). Verdicts are schema-validated, cached ~2h per chat state, capped (6/scan, 3 concurrent, scan time budget), and on failure the tick **waits** instead of sending blindly; all-failed scans pause the judge briefly. **Doing** shows `Judge: …` rows; docs list the new env vars.
> 
> New `judge.js` builds the prompt from PR/CI facts, the agent’s last message, recent nudges, and the planned nudge, using a stripped Codex home (provider only, no MCP/hooks). `policy.repeatsLastSend` blocks judge **send** when it would duplicate an unreplied nudge.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit cc2d8c27afa96884765f226132b43e98896897aa. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

## Owner Review Card（agent 填）

### 1. Problem

PR #1993（SPEC v0.2.0）已被 Owner 合并，随后 Owner 以 REQUEST CHANGES 提出两项 P1 设计缺陷（P1-01 守卫存在性检查可被旧事实重放绕过；P1-02 operation_key 依赖确定性复用的 approvalId）。本 PR 承载修复后的 SPEC v0.3.0 增量（rebase 到最新 main，仅含 3 份文档的 +123/-37 差量）。

---

### 2. Before

v0.2.0 的 §4.4.3 守卫是存在性检查：事实永久存在，重放首次激活的 `INSERT OR REPLACE` 可匹配旧事实、把已停用原则无事实复活（Owner 复现，本 PR 作者以 better-sqlite3 15 项检查再证实）；v0.2.0 的 `operation_key = …|<approvalId>` 假设再激活产生新批准 ID，而 `apr_<channel>_<artifactId>` 是 `INSERT OR IGNORE` 的可复用队列槽位（且 `verifyApprovedDispatch` 不查 `decided_at`、激活不消费批准行——现网存在陈旧已批准行无新批准即可再激活的潜在重放面）。

---

### 3. After

v0.3.0：守卫升级为**未消费性检查**（匹配事实必须是该 key 当前最新转移事实，`event_id` 确定性决胜；UPDATE 守卫同谓词，顺带封死对称旧事实绕过）；`operation_key` 改为与批准身份分离的**请求参数摘要**（失败重试同键、真实再激活新键新 occurrence、无随机 ID）；新增 **approval-epoch 新鲜度规则**（激活的 `decided_at` 必须晚于主体最新停用事实，否则拒绝 `approval_epoch_stale`——收紧审批门、闭合潜在重放面，不放松任何审批/break-glass/认证要求）。AC-17（陈旧事实重放封死套件）与 AC-18（批准新鲜度正负对照）新增；OD-10（Owner 批准该行为变化）新增；INV-04 重述为两级幂等；评审报告 v1.1.0 记录 Owner 轮次与复现证据（15/15）。

---

### 4. Existing mechanism reused

不可变触发器模式（`activation_decisions_no_update/no_delete`）、SELECT-first 幂等先例（`safety-store.ts:341-350`）、幂等键格式先例（`supersede-prompt:*`）、连接层 pragma 验证模式（`sqlite-connection.ts:135-158`）、版本化迁移 002 先例——全部与 v0.2.0 相同；v0.3.0 新增消费的既有事实是 approval store/dispatcher 的真实代码行为（`sqlite-approval-store.ts:138-157,258-265`、`activation-dispatcher.ts:537-600,644-646`）。

---

### 5. Complexity Delta

* New durable source of truth: NO
* New persisted schema/state: NO
* New subsystem/service/background process: NO
* New public abstraction/interface: NO
* New runtime feature flag: NO
* New cross-package dependency: NO
* New host/platform-specific behavior: NO
* New external/network capability: NO

（与 v0.2.0 一致：纯文档；SPEC 设计的守卫谓词不引入新状态——消费性由既有事实的时间序天然表达，无需授权标记表或投影版本列。）

---

### 6. Verification

* P1-01 复现套件 15/15（better-sqlite3 真实引擎）：v0.2.0 语义下绕过证实（A1-A4）；v0.3.0 语义下攻击路径全部 ABORT（陈旧 INSERT 重放、T4 后 T3 重放、旧事实 UPDATE、无事实写、DELETE）、合法路径全部保留（首激/停用/真实再激活/同态幂等重写/W03 双键原子替换）——报告 Appendix B；
* P1-02 代码事实核验：`sqlite-approval-store.ts:138-140,155-157,258-265`、`activation-dispatcher.ts:537-600,644-646` 实读引用进 SPEC；
* rebase 后 diff 仅 3 份文档（+123/-37），`check:docs-structure` PASS；commit 钩子与 pre-push `verify-merge` PASS（host-runtime tsc 在默认堆下 OOM，按仓库既有做法以 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` 运行后 124.71s 全绿——PRI-915 已知环境坑）。

---

### 7. Risk

守卫谓词在 SQL 语义层已验证、工程真相待 Phase B red-first 测试（AC-17/AC-18 是强制门）；approval-epoch 规则改变"陈旧已批准行可重复放行"的现状（这是有意的收紧，OD-10 交 Owner 裁决）。

Before: 화면 색이 하나뿐이고 어두운 모드가 없었습니다. 블로그에는 태그와 어울리는 그림이 없고, 대표 이미지를 올리지 않은 블로그는 위쪽이 비어 있었습니다.

After: 정돈된 목록형 디자인으로 바뀌고, 오른쪽 위 🌙/☀️ 버튼으로 밝은/어두운 모드를 바꿉니다(처음엔 기기 설정을 따름). 블로그 화면 제목 옆과 블로그 카드 이름 앞에 작은 픽셀 마스코트가 움직입니다. 마스코트는 바탕 18종(동물 10, 물건 8)에 색 6가지, 모자, 장식을 더한 조합이라 블로그끼리 겹치지 않습니다. 대표 이미지를 올리지 않은 블로그는 대표 이미지 자리에 움직이는 큰 픽셀 장면(14가지)이 보이고, 배치가 블로그마다 달라 같은 장면이라도 그림이 다릅니다. 블로그를 만들거나 이름·태그를 바꿀 때마다 둘 다 새로 만듭니다.

Claude가 이름과 태그를 읽고 마스코트 조합과 장면·시간·날씨·색을 고릅니다. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`가 없거나 호출이 실패하면 단어 사전으로 고릅니다. 이미 있는 블로그는 10분마다 20개씩 채웁니다.

How:

author: puohecbhad-bit
body:
## 为什么

- **安全**：0.1.0 安装到 `C:\ProgramData\CampusLogin`，并由 SYSTEM 运行其中的程序。Windows 默认允许普通用户在 ProgramData 下新建文件夹，安装器发现目录已存在时会直接沿用。在共用电脑上，有人可以抢先建好这个目录并放入文件，以后以 SYSTEM 身份执行（根据 Windows 默认权限推断，没有在实机上复现）。
- **学生用起来更简单**：原来需要解压 ZIP、保留 `_internal` 文件夹；“打开日志目录”还会遇到权限提示，如果点“继续”，Windows 会把当前用户加入目录权限，也就能读取保存的密码。

## 改了什么

- 安装到 `%ProgramFiles%\CampusLogin`；安装成功后，只删除旧 ProgramData 目录里 0.1.0 写过的文件（不经过链接），目录空了才删除。第一次升级时，GUI 会读取旧目录里的网络名、网卡和账号（密码仍需重新填写）。
- `-Uninstall -RemoveData`：卸载时同时删除凭据、日志和程序文件；GUI 卸载时会询问。
- GUI 用“查看运行状态”代替“打开日志目录”：在已提权的窗口里显示任务状态，用中文解释最新一条记录（后台程序出错、意外退出都能识别；任务没有运行时不会显示旧的成功记录），并附上原始日志。安装 8 秒后会自动显示第一条结果。
- 后台程序每次状态变化（等待校园网 / 已在线 / 网络查询出错后恢复）记录一行，让日志能看出程序在运行。
- 发布物改为单个 `CampusLoginSetup-v<ver>-windows-x64.exe`（PyInstaller onefile）、`.sha256` 和第三方许可说明；`README.release.md` 改写成面向学生的说明，包括 SmartScreen 怎么放行。
- README 的 release 链接改成相对链接；`VERSION` 改为 0.2.0，延续 v0.1.0 之后的版本序列。

## 验证

- Tests：windows-latest / ubuntu-latest × Python 3.11 / 3.14 全部通过，47 个测试，Windows 上没有跳过。新增测试覆盖安装路径、`-RemoveData`、升级时读取旧设置、出错后恢复的记录、状态摘要不会显示过期的成功结果。
- Build Windows release（`workflow_dispatch`，在本分支上）通过：产物为 `CampusLoginSetup-v0.2.0-windows-x64.exe`，冒烟测试显示 version 0.2.0，预览安装路径为 `C:\Program Files\CampusLogin`。
- **没有**在真实 Windows 机器上安装、走 UAC 重启，也没有在校园网上做真实认证。

author: 0x054
body:
Part of #623 (panel fix round for PR #636; #625 and #627's files)

## F4: a retired label on a plain `Enum` is now refused

Before this change, the guard only checked values that were a `str`. A field typed as a plain `class Status(Enum): CANCELED = "canceled"` holds the member after validation, and that member is not a `str`. So `Order(status=Status.CANCELED)` and `order.status = Status.CANCELED` wrote the retired label without any error.

Now one helper, `written_retired_label`, compares the value that would actually be written: `member.value` for any enum member, or the raw string. The construction validator and the class-level `__setattr__` both use it. The `__setattr__` is still installed only when `validate_assignment` is off. The guard stays per-field, and `Model` gets no `__setattr__` of its own. Hydration still bypasses the guard (I-2).

Tests in `tests/test_retired_labels.py`:
- `test_a_plain_enum_refuses_the_retired_label_on_construction[False|True]`
- `test_a_plain_enum_refuses_the_retired_label_on_assignment[False|True]`
- `test_a_hydrated_plain_enum_retired_row_changes_another_field_and_saves`, which runs on both backends with both `validate_assignment` settings

## F5: the retired primary-key refusal names its fix

The refusal now reads:

```
Author.id: a primary key cannot be retired; drop `retired=True`. To remove the key, change the primary key first: see the Migrations docs § Changing a primary key
```

The migrations guide's list of refusals now gives the fix for this case too, as it does for the others. Test: `tests/test_retired_columns.py::test_retiring_a_primary_key_is_refused_naming_the_fix` pins the full text.

## F8: `update()` refuses a retired enum label

Before this change, `Model.where(...).update(status=Status.CANCELED)` wrote the retired label to every matching row.

Now the literal SETs for both keyword `update(status=...)` and the recipe form `update(lambda o: {"status": ...})` go through `refuse_retired_label_write` (in `metaclass.py`) before anything is compiled. It uses the same by-value comparison as F4 and raises the same `retired_enum_label` `ValidationError`. Column copies and arithmetic are not literals, so they are not checked: an enum column cannot be an arithmetic target.

Test: `test_update_refuses_the_retired_label_and_writes_nothing`. It covers keyword and recipe × `StrEnum` and plain `Enum` × sqlite and postgres, for both the member and the raw string. It also checks that the row is unchanged and that a later `update()` without the label still works.

cargo check --all-targets                               -> exit 0
uv run pytest -v tests/test_ir_vectors_contract.py      -> exit 0, 14 passed
uv run pytest --db-backends=sqlite,postgres tests/test_retired_labels.py tests/test_retired_columns.py tests/test_schema_enum_annotations.py tests/test_enum_cold_hydration.py tests/test_generate_enum_removal.py tests/test_generate_retired.py tests/test_hydration.py tests/test_docs_examples.py tests/test_docs_migrations.py
                                                        -> exit 0, 438 passed

```

None. The changed files are `src/ferro/metaclass.py`, `src/ferro/query/wire.py`, `tests/test_retired_labels.py`, `tests/test_retired_columns.py` and the one retirement sentence in `docs/pages/guide/schema/migrations.md`. `models.py` and `ir/compiler.py` are unchanged.

author: quick104
body:
## Problem

Related issue: #2320
Validation tasks: none

An API server that is told to stop closes its listeners within milliseconds, while `GET /api/v1/ready` keeps answering `200` until the very end. A load balancer or Kubernetes therefore has no moment to route new requests to another replica first, and requests that arrive during a rolling restart fail. This change makes a stopping API server fail readiness first and keep serving for a few seconds before it shuts down.

## Approach

On SIGTERM or SIGINT the API process marks itself as shutting down. `/api/v1/ready` then answers `503` with `{"status":"shutting_down","postgres":…,"s3":…,"artwork":…}`, the same shape as its other non-ok answers. The booleans report the last dependency probe, so the answer does not wait on a slow storage probe. The LAN discovery advertisement is withdrawn. The server keeps serving everything for `SILO_SHUTDOWN_DELAY` (a duration or whole seconds, default `5s`, `0` skips the wait), then runs the existing graceful shutdown. A second signal ends the wait. `/api/v1/health`, the liveness probe, does not change, so nothing restarts the process while it waits.

The application context is now cancelled after the wait instead of at the signal, so background work keeps running while the server still answers requests. A restart request still stops at once, and ends the wait if it arrives during it: an administrator's restart has already told players the server is restarting, and the loss of storage admission sends one after it has stopped storage writers. A failed listener also stops the process at once, during the wait or not.

The example compose `silo` service and proxy get `stop_grace_period: 2m`, since Docker's default 10-second kill already cut the existing 30-second graceful shutdown short. The development compose file and `make dev-backend` set the delay to `0`, because `air` kills the process half a second after interrupting it. `docs/architecture/api-shutdown.md` describes the sequence and the Docker and Kubernetes settings, and the retained probe contract in `api-contract.md` records `shutting_down` as an additive status, like `degraded`.

No client calls `/api/v1/ready`; the Apple and Android reachability checks read `/api/v1/health`, which does not change. The Jellyfin-compatible and Audiobookshelf-compatible listeners have no readiness probe and close as before. Transcode nodes drain separately in #2340.

## Validation

- Before, on a sandbox, polling every 100 ms through a SIGTERM to the API: readiness answered `200 ok` until the listener closed 5 ms after the signal, then connections were refused.
- After: readiness answered `503 shutting_down` within 100 ms of the signal while health stayed `200`, and the graceful shutdown began 5.0 s later. A second SIGTERM one second after the first started the shutdown at once.
- Unit tests cover the readiness answer while shutting down (without waiting on a new probe) and without a signal, the delay parsing, and the wait ending after its delay, at a second signal, a restart request or a listener error.
- `go build`, `go vet` and `make lint-changed` (0 issues) pass, as do the tests of `internal/api`, `internal/api/handlers`, `internal/scenariocatalog`, `internal/contractledger` and `cmd/silo`. No web or generated contract changes.

## Evidence

Evidence: https://evidence.siloserver.org/r/silo-server/api-shutdown-readiness/

## Risks

- Every stop of an API server by signal now takes `SILO_SHUTDOWN_DELAY` longer, 5 seconds by default. A single server with no load balancer can set it to `0`.
- Background work (schedulers, scans, the node health sweep) keeps running for those seconds instead of stopping at the signal, and work it starts then is cut when the shutdown begins, as it would be a moment later anyway.
- `nodeDrainTimeout` in #2340 parses its variable the same way; whichever pull request merges second can share one helper.
- A monitor that treats any non-`200` readiness as an outage alerts for the seconds a server spends stopping.

## Follow-ups

- User manual: Silo-Server/siloserver.org#187, draft docs PR Silo-Server/siloserver.org#188.

## Checklist

- [x] I read and can explain the complete diff.
- [x] This pull request addresses one concern.
- [x] The Evidence section shows every change a user can see, or says there is none.

## AI Disclosure

- Harness: Claude Code, running in T3 Code
- Tool(s): Claude Code subagents; Codex CLI through T3 Code task delegation
- Model(s): claude-opus-5-5 (implementation and review), claude-sonnet-5-5 (review finder), gpt-6.1-sol (adversarial review)
- Involvement: Fully AI-generated; maintainer review pending
- Adversarial review: a multi-agent Claude review (two finders, one on correctness and contracts, one on cleanup and conventions) checked the diff. It found that a restart request after lost storage admission would have kept serving with storage writers stopped, that `air` would kill the dev server mid-wait, that LAN discovery kept advertising during the wait, an overflow in the seconds form, an unbounded test wait, and stale docs (grace-period sizing, `blob-storage.md`, listener scope). All were fixed. A background Codex (gpt-6.1-sol) review then found that a restart request, storage admission loss or listener failure arriving during the wait stayed queued until the delay ended. The wait now stops at once for each. A Kody review then found that readiness probed its dependencies before checking for shutdown, so a hung storage probe could delay the `shutting_down` answer by the whole default delay; it now reports the last probe.

body:
Closes #1070

## 概要
「検証する」という動作だけで立っていた `src/domains/dcmp/design-document/validation/` を削除した。

- **走査**（どの部品・artboard・子ノード・名前を見るか）: `DesignDocument` 本体（`design-document/index.ts`）の非公開関数 `collectTypedPropErrors` / `collectNodeErrors` / `collectNodeRefErrors` / `collectBindingErrors` / `collectComponentErrors` / `collectArtboardErrors` / `collectNameErrors`
- **詰め替え**（違反 1 件 → `DesignDocumentValidationError`。文言・位置を含む）: 新設 `design-document/validation-error/index.ts` に型 + 同名コンパニオン（`from*` 13 個）。`edit-error/` と同じ形
- 中間型 `UnlocatedError` / `withLocation` は廃止し、各 `from*` が位置を引数で受ける。`from*` は既存の `from*` と同じく第 1 引数を変換元にしている
- 親 `index.ts` からの公開は従来どおり型だけ（外部 import は型 2 件のみで変更なし）
- `DesignDocument.collectErrors` の出力（位置・文言・`prop` キーの有無・並び順）は変えていない

判断の履歴（計画・却下案・レビューの採否）は #1070 のコメントにある。

## 変更ファイル
| ファイル | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `src/domains/dcmp/design-document/validation/index.ts` | 削除 |
| `src/domains/dcmp/design-document/validation-error/index.ts` | 新規。型 + `DesignDocumentValidationError.from*` |
| `src/domains/dcmp/design-document/index.ts` | 走査関数を追加、import を差し替え、doc を走査が本体にある形に揃える |
| `src/domains/dcmp/design-document/token-referrer/index.ts` | doc の参照先を本体の `collectArtboardErrors` へ |
| `docs/05-architecture.md` | `validator` 行の実体を本体と `validation-error` へ |
| `__tests__/design-document.validate-error-shape.test.ts` | 旧 `validate-reference-message` をリネームし、エラー配列全体を `toStrictEqual` で固定 |
| `__tests__/design-document.validate-order.test.ts` | 種類をまたぐ並びのテストを追加 |

`validation-error/` には `__tests__/` を置いていない。`from*` を直接呼ぶテストは移動前に存在しない API で出力不変の証拠にならず、文言を 2 か所で固定するため。13 個の `from*` はすべて `collectErrors` 経由で `validate-error-shape` が `toStrictEqual` で固定している。

body:
## 요약
맨 처음 '문 열기' 화면을 새로 만들었습니다. 오픈소스 애니메이션 라이브러리 **anime.js v3.2.2**([juliangarnier/anime](https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime), MIT 라이선스)를 썼습니다.

### 문 디자인
- 금빛 문틀, 판넬이 새겨진 문짝(앞면과 뒷면), 놋쇠 손잡이를 넣었습니다.
- 닫힌 문 오른쪽 틈새로 빛이 은은하게 새어 나오고, 문 안쪽에서는 빛줄기가 천천히 돕니다.
- 기다리는 동안 문이 살짝 떠 있고, 화면에는 금빛 먼지가 떠다닙니다(캔버스로 직접 그림).

### 여는 연출 (약 3.4초)
1. 글자와 버튼이 조용히 물러납니다.
2. 손잡이가 돌아갑니다.
3. 문이 3D로 활짝 열립니다. 처음엔 무겁게, 끝은 부드럽게 움직이고, 열리는 순간 금빛 빛가루가 터져 나옵니다.
4. 문 안의 빛이 커지면서, 문 안으로 걸어 들어가듯 화면이 다가가고 빛가루가 스쳐 지나갑니다.
5. 빛이 화면을 가득 채운 뒤 걷히면서 첫 화면이 흐림 속에서 선명하게 제자리를 찾습니다.
- 소리를 켜 두면 문이 열릴 때 '스으' 하는 바람 소리가 납니다.
- 필름 같은 고운 입자를 얹어, 그라데이션에 생기는 줄무늬를 없앴습니다.

### 안전장치
- 라이브러리를 불러오지 못하면 예전 방식의 간단한 문 열기로 대체합니다.
- '움직임 줄이기' 설정에서는 연출 없이 바로 들어갑니다.
- 버튼과 문을 연달아 눌러도 한 번만 실행됩니다.
- 라이브러리 파일과 라이선스 원문은 `js/vendor/`에 넣었고, README에 표기했습니다.

## 확인한 내용
헤드리스 Chromium에서 확인했습니다.
- 데스크톱과 휴대폰에서 타임라인을 시점별로 멈춰 프레임을 찍었습니다. 휴대폰처럼 세로로 긴 화면은 빛이 화면 전체를 채우도록 더 깊이 들어가게 조정했습니다.
- 버튼 클릭, 문 클릭, 연속 클릭, 건너뛰기, 움직임 줄이기, `#ask` 링크로 바로 들어오기, 라이브러리가 없을 때, 영어 화면 모두 끝까지 정상 진입하고 자바스크립트 오류가 없습니다.
- 기능 점검 44개 항목이 모두 통과했습니다. 점검 스크립트의 인트로 대기 시간(2.8초 → 4.2초)과 '한쪽 색 상자' 예외 목록(새 문 그림의 테두리 음영)만 새 연출에 맞게 고쳤습니다.

## 概要

1. AI エージェント向けの知恵 skill とは別に、人が教訓として読むためのアウトプット「教訓かるた」を追加しました。
2. Claude Docs から新しいエッセイ2本を取り込み、知恵を抽出しました（知恵 22件 → 27件）。

## 1. 教訓かるた

知恵1件を、次の4つで1枚の札にしています。

- **格言**: 一行で覚えられる言葉（例: 「火を消したら、火元を探せ」）
- **寓話**: 教訓を一つの出来事として見せる短い話（創作。出典エッセイの話ではないことをページに明記）
- **教訓**: 格言の意味を平易に言い直したもの（知恵カードの主張に沿う）
- **問い**: 読み手が自分に投げかける問い

変更内容
- `lessons/<theme>.md`：札の本文。知恵カードと同じ ID・同じテーマ分け
- `lessons/index.html`：札をカード形式で読むページ（縦書きの格言、テーマ絞り込み、「一枚引く」、札を開くと寓話・教訓・問い）。`scripts/build_lessons.py` で生成
- `lessons/README.md`：教訓集の入口と一覧表（一覧表も `build_lessons.py` が生成）
- `scripts/check.py`：有効な知恵カードと札が一対一でそろっているか、札に必要な項目があるかを検査
- CI：`build_lessons.py --check` で `index.html` と一覧表が最新かを検査
- `extract-wisdom` skill / README / CLAUDE.md：知恵を追加したら札も書く手順を追加

## 2. エッセイと知恵の追加

| 日付 | エッセイ | 図 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-10-12 | 宝くじ1枚の期待値はなぜ判断を誤らせるのか | 3点（SVG に起こした） |
| 2026-10-12 | AIがサイゼリヤの間違い探しを解けるようになるまで | なし |

新しい知恵
| ID | 原則 | 出典 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W-0023 | 一回きりの選択では、期待値ではなく、起こりうる結果の散らばりとそれぞれの重みで判断する | 宝くじ |
| W-0024 | 目標の数に届いたことを完了の合図にせず、数え方が正しいかと手順を終えたかで終わりを決める | 間違い探し |
| W-0025 | 守りたい手順は、文章のルールを書き足すのではなく、飛ばせない仕組みにする | 間違い探し |
| W-0026 | 手法や対策が効いたかは、印象ではなく正解のある問題で測り、調整に使っていない問題でも確かめる | 間違い探し |
| W-0027 | 候補を捨てる・ノイズと判断する前に、根拠を見える形に並べて確かめる | 間違い探し |

既存カードの補強（ID は維持し、出典を追加して指針を1つずつ足した）
- W-0003：完了の合図を別のものに移しただけでは解けていない
- W-0012：期待値を根拠にするときに捨てている情報を確かめる（宝くじ）
- W-0018：自分の失敗の原因分析も、試してから再発防止策にする
- W-0022：残すか捨てるかを一つの物差しだけで測らない

間違い探しのエッセイは、Claude が知恵袋の W-0003・W-0018・W-0022 を実際に使って自分のやり方を見直した記録なので、これらのカードの出典に加えています。

その他
- `import_docs.py`：署名が「文：名前」の文書にも対応
- README：抽出手順の番号の重複を修正

## 確認したこと
- `python3 scripts/check.py` → `OK: エッセイ 10 本 / 知恵 27 件`
- `python3 scripts/build_lessons.py --check` → 最新
- 教訓かるたのページをデスクトップ（ライト）とスマホ幅（ダーク）で描画し、横スクロールやコンソールエラーがないこと、札を開けることを確認
- 札を1件消すと `check.py` がエラーになることを確認
- Claude Docs からの書き出しはデコード後のバイト数を照合し、本文を通読。図は描画して元の図と見比べた

author: fheikens
body:
Closes #123.

## What

The image builds upstream `pgagroal` from source at tag **2.1.0**, which ships unpatched memory-safety weaknesses in the **client-facing startup-packet parse path**. Upstream coordinated disclosure stalled (no advisory process, no patched release); the same vulnerability class is now public upstream (`pgagroal/pgagroal#1016/#1051/#1020`, fix PRs unmerged). We patch the paid product ourselves rather than wait.

Carries a **validated upstream-candidate fix** (sanitizer + regression tested) as a build-time overlay on the pinned 2.1.0 source — **not** a fork (ADR-0001): removed once upstream ships a release carrying it and `PGAGROAL_VERSION` is bumped.

## Changes
- `patches/0001-harden-client-startup-packet-parser.patch` — startup packet as a validation boundary + centralized bounded field copies (`pgagroal_copy_bounded`) for username/database/application_name in `security.c` + `utils.c`. Applies cleanly to 2.1.0.
- `Dockerfile` — applies `patches/` after `git clone`, before `cmake`, with a **fail-loud** `git apply --check` guard (a future `PGAGROAL_VERSION` bump that breaks a patch STOPS the build instead of shipping unpatched/double-patched).
- `PATCHES.md` — provenance + removal condition; no reproducer/exploit detail.
- `VERSION` + Chart `version` → **1.4.6**; CHANGELOG Security entry.

## Verified
- Patch applies cleanly to upstream 2.1.0 (`git apply --check`).
- Full `docker build` succeeds: patch applied during build and pgagroal **recompiled with it**; resulting binary runs (`pgagroal 2.1.0`).
- hadolint clean (no errors).

## Not in scope (follow-up)
Backend-facing parse fixes — `pgagroal/pgagroal#1016` (`query_system_identifier`/`server_probe`), `#1051` (`pgagroal_extract_message`), `#1020` (auth memory lifetime). Available upstream fixes (`#1017`/`#1052`) are third-party and need security review before entering the paid product.

## Release note
Cutting the **v1.4.6** tag (which ships the patched image to customers) is a human gate, to be done after merge.

author: bittersmilezzz
body:
> **Stacked**：#74 → … → #88 → 本 PR。

## 「发布」这一半此前只有构建被验证过

前面每一波都在证明「一套开发」；而「**多处发布**」这条通道（tag → 三系统安装包 → Release）**从未真正跑过**。这一波把能本地验证的部分全部变成可验证的，并修掉一处写反的文档事实。

## ① 三端图标：一份美术，三端格式

jpackage 不交叉编译，也不认「一种图标走三端」——macOS 要 `.icns`、Windows 要 `.ico`、Linux 要 `.png`。按第一原则，**美术只有一份**：

```
apps/mac/Resources/AppIcon.iconset  ──tools/generate_app_icons.py──▶  shared/icons/{AppIcon.icns,.ico,.png}
```

- `.ico` 含 **16/24/32/48/64/128/256** 七档（少档位会在任务栏/资源管理器/Alt-Tab 各取一档而糊）；
- `--check` 模式给「看不到 diff 的二进制产物」做存在性校验；
- 打包任务依赖 `:desktop:verifyAppIcons`：**图标缺失时在打包这一步就失败并给出生成命令**，而不是静默套上 jpackage 的默认图标。

**实测证据**：本机 `:desktop:packageDmg` 出包后，bundle 内 `Contents/Resources/KnowFlick.icns` 与 `shared/icons/AppIcon.icns` **SHA256 逐字节一致**（Info.plist 的 `CFBundleIconFile` 也指向它）。

## ② 发布附件组装：脚本成为唯一实现，可本地空跑

`tools/assemble_desktop_release.sh` 承担「校验 tag 版本 → 统一命名 → 校验和 → 附 Release」，**workflow 直接调它**，不在 YAML 里再抄一遍。理由：这条通道只在打 tag 时走，藏在 YAML 里的 shell 没法空跑。

本机空跑（真实 DMG + 两个占位 msi/deb）验证了命名映射——注意 `KnowFlick-1.0.0.dmg`（jpackage 的 MAJOR>0 别名）→ `KnowFlick-0.1.0-macos.dmg`（产品版本），这个容易搞错的点现在可复现：

```
  · KnowFlick-1.0.0.dmg          →  KnowFlick-0.1.0-macos.dmg
  · KnowFlick-0.1.0.msi          →  KnowFlick-0.1.0-windows.msi
  · knowflick_0.1.0-1_amd64.deb  →  KnowFlick-0.1.0-linux.deb
```

三个守卫逐条验证：tag 版本与配置不符 → 退出 1；缺任一产物 → 退出 1；tag 前缀不对 → 退出 2。

顺带修一个**只在 CI 会炸**的隐患：校验和原先只用 `shasum`，而 Ubuntu runner 默认是 `sha256sum`——现在两者都兜住。

## ③ 修一处写反的文档事实

仓库旧文档写着「`paths` 过滤对 tag 推送同样生效，所以 tag 要打在包含桌面改动的提交上」。**这是错的**：

> Path filters are not evaluated for pushes of tags.
> —— [GitHub Docs: workflow syntax, `on.<push>.paths`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#onpushpull_requestpull_request_targetpathspaths-ignore)

同一个 `push` 块里同时写 `tags:` 与 `paths:` 是安全的，tag 一定会触发。已改正并附出处（`docs/MULTI_PLATFORM.md` + `desktop.yml` 头部注释）。

## ④ AGENTS 陷阱（实测）

**Gradle 的任务输入校验先于任何 `doFirst` 执行**——想在「任务输入缺失」时给友好提示，`doFirst` 里守不住（实测：图标缺失时打包任务在动作执行前就因输入校验失败）。正确形态是**独立校验任务 + `dependsOn`**。

## 验证

| 验证 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `./tools/build_android.sh` | 全绿（360 项） |
| `generate_app_icons.py --check` | 通过（三个产物并列 sha256） |
| 发布脚本空跑 + 三个守卫 | 符合预期 |
| 图标内嵌 | 与共享产物逐字节一致 |
| `.ico` / `.png` 交叉验证 | 由本 PR 的 desktop.yml 三系统 matrix 在 CI 完成 |

author: kqns91
body:
## 概要
GitHub Actions のサプライチェーン対策と権限の最小化をまとめて行います。Dependabot の #24〜#28 を置き換えるもので、マージ後に Dependabot が自動で閉じる見込みです。

## 変更内容
### 1. Actions を最新版に更新し、コミット SHA で固定
タグは後から付け替えられるため、作者側が乗っ取られると中身を差し替えられます（2026 年 3 月の `trivy-action` の事件など）。すべてコミット SHA で固定し、バージョンをコメントで残します。以後の更新は Dependabot が SHA とコメントを合わせて行います。

| Action | 変更前 | 変更後 | 置き換える PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actions/checkout` | `@v4` | `@3d3c42e…` v7.0.1 | #25 |
| `actions/setup-go` | `@v5` | `@b7ad1da…` v7.0.0 | #24 |
| `golangci/golangci-lint-action` | `@v8` | `@ba0d7d2…` v9.3.0 | #27 |
| `goreleaser/goreleaser-action` | `@v6` | `@f06c13b…` v7.2.3 | #26 |
| `go-semantic-release/action` | `@v1` | `@2e9dc42…` v1.24.1 | — |
| `codecov/codecov-action` | `@v4` | **削除** | #28 |

SHA は各リポジトリのリリースタグから取得しています。`security.yml` はすでに SHA 固定済みで、最新版のため変更していません。

各 Action のメジャーアップデートの主な変更点は実行環境の Node 24 化で、GitHub ホストのランナーではそのまま動作します。

### 2. ワークフローの権限を最小化
- `release.yml`: `contents: write` をワークフロー全体からリリースジョブだけに限定し、テストジョブは読み取り専用にしました。
- `ci.yml`: `permissions: contents: read` を明示しました（これまではリポジトリのデフォルト設定に依存）。

### 3. `persist-credentials: false`
すべての checkout でトークンをディスクに残さないようにしました。リリースは go-semantic-release（`github-token` 入力）と GoReleaser（`GITHUB_TOKEN` 環境変数）が API で行い、`git fetch --tags` は公開リポジトリのため認証不要なので、影響はありません。

### 4. Codecov のアップロードを削除
`CODECOV_TOKEN` が登録されておらず、実質使われていなかったため削除しました。カバレッジの表示（`go tool cover -func`）は残しています。

## 確認したこと
- `actionlint` でワークフローの構文を確認
- `ci.yml` と `security.yml` はこの PR の CI で動作確認されます

## 注意
`release.yml`（setup-go / checkout / go-semantic-release / GoReleaser）は PR の CI では実行されません。次に `main` へマージしたとき、Release ワークフローが成功することを確認してください。リリース対象のコミットがない場合も、テストと go-semantic-release までは動くので、そこで新しい Action の動作を確認できます。

`ci:` のみのためリリースは発生しません。

author: effortlesssteven
body:
## Claim
A copied main xtask executable can explicitly select another worktree with `--worktree-root PATH`. Previously, task helpers embedded the checkout that built the runner, so invocation from B could still inspect or write A.

## Controlling issue
Fixes #17603. The #13697 environment/fixture work and #17601 compression work retain their scope and owners.

## Governing contract
Explicit selection validates the Git root, workspace repository identity and xtask package before dispatch. A directory inside the worktree is accepted. Invalid targets and inherited GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY or GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES (including empty values) fail without fallback. Omission preserves existing defaults.

## Changed production path
CLI dispatch selects the worktree and enters its root before invoking a task. Binary and library callers share the existing utils module and one selected-root state. RIPR task-root resolution now uses that helper, preventing impacted-evidence reports from being written into the compiled checkout.

Per-command explicit fixture roots and intentional compiled-source manifest/corpus consumers, including CPAN and legacy corpus lookup, retain their contracts. This selects the runtime task subject and cwd; it does not make mutable Cargo outputs portable.

## Proof
Candidate `d03473b487448ae63a70b9ede3b9666e8bff9d8c`, base `40269196754c9114238df694bbbdd3c853548579`.
All Cargo execution used native admission with command-scoped budgets and private outputs. Fresh behavioral proof ran on the repaired working source; source hashes match the committed candidate.
- PASS: `test -p xtask --bin xtask --test runtime_worktree_cli --test change_set_cli --test activation_cwd_independence --profile agent --locked`: 4,763 main tests, three runtime tests, seven change-set tests and one activation test passed; one existing ignored.
- PASS: package formatting and diff whitespace check.
- PASS: copied ordinary runner against disposable worktrees from outside, B and nested directories, nested explicit target, invalid-target dispatch controls and RIPR report location in B.
- PASS: independently reproduced foreign `GIT_INDEX_FILE` admission in the prior runner; repaired copy refuses empty and actual foreign index/object paths before dispatch. Regression checks all six inherited Git root/index/object overrides for empty and nonempty values.
- Runner SHA-256: `3cf79fa7b651c3ee287de5ed4fd39ae8961f5ef3844623932d7671aa814d805d`; 321,810,608 bytes. Copied under native build ownership and matched again after the passing test run.
- Terminal candidate-private target/build footprint: 4,723,724,288 allocated bytes, inode-deduplicated. Peak was not measured. Native supervisor reaped descendants and released its matching lease.
- Original wrong-root baseline used unchanged utils.rs in a small probe; that remains helper-level evidence. Current behavior is tested through the full ordinary executable.

## Hosted proof
All five protected required contexts passed on `d03473b487448ae63a70b9ede3b9666e8bff9d8c` from GitHub Actions15368: Compile All Targets, Conflict marker check, validate-title, Perl LSP Rust Small Result and ripr+ New Gap Gate. The selected hosted Rust Small and RIPR producers succeeded. Protected expected-head squash merged this PR as `d5d88abcd3511eafafedf59748a110b4a0e9ec91`, parent `94db4f5669876ad5d895dab3ae63be1fe982de2c`. Issue17603 closed as completed. Exact merge-parent delta contains only the five reviewed paths, whose bytes match D034.

PR Smoke advisory failed a preexisting missing `watched_delete_republish_tests` LSP layer row. Its test and raw module input are byte-identical to review base4026; the exact base-input std-only test reproduced the same assertion under native admission. No full-package base pass is claimed. The unrelated table and coverage were preserved.

Prior all-targets Clippy on `391e0f101e` FAILED: 150 parsed diagnostic locations in 18 base-identical files, with no then-changed-file diagnostic. The later selector repair has fresh compile/tests, not another all-targets lint run; no lint pass is claimed.

## Test hardening
The copied runner distinguishes B's unique Git changes and Cargo package name across different invocation directories, nested and relative targets, a linked worktree with spaces, per-command root precedence and omitted-selector defaults. Invalid/nonrepository/unrelated targets must fail before successful list-commands dispatch. RIPR reports must appear in B without changing A. A fresh child checks selected library roots and unchanged compiled-source corpus access.

## Simplification
Reuse the existing utils library instead of compiling a second binary copy. No runner framework, new package, environment wrapper or duplicated resolver.

## Deviations
Explicit selection is opt-in to preserve commands that deliberately use compiled source. The new selector requires UTF-8 Git path output and leaves existing output-admission contracts intact.

## Claim Boundary
This qualifies runtime selection and refusal on Linux. It does not qualify mutable output reuse, independent Cargo environment isolation, all platforms, or installed product behavior. Internal tooling only; product changelog/support/release migration is not applicable.

## Non-goals
No desktop, credential, security-policy, release, deployment, history-rewrite, cleanup, workflow/protection or coverage changes. Documentation remains in the multi-worktree guide. Current repository metadata reports has_pages=false; docs-deploy.yml deploys only when its Pages check returns HTTP 200. The docs path can trigger a build, but Pages deployment is expected to skip while disabled. No hosting setting or workflow changed.

## Risk and rollback
Explicit selection changes cwd, so relative task paths resolve from the selected root. Remove the flag to retain existing defaults; reverting this coherent change restores the previous runner. No persisted input migration.

## Review index
Independent candidate/proof review resolved the RIPR bypass, shared-root state, corpus proof limitations and foreign index/object admission. The affected repair review found no remaining material issue. [Root cumulative review](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/perl-lsp-swarm/pull/17610#pullrequestreview-5486315778) and required live checks are separate judgments.

body:
## Summary

**Owners on chat apps**
- `access.first_chat_owner` is off by default. When it is on, the first person to write to the bot in a private chat on an app with no owner yet becomes that app's owner, and is saved to `access.owners` in config.toml.
  - This applies to QQ, Feishu and Zulip, and each app gets its own owner.
  - Groups and email never claim ownership.
  - The Gateway reads `access` from the live settings, so the new owner applies at once.
- "Revoke a chat owner" removes the owner you pick. It is in `config` under Access and spending › Access, and `init` offers it too.
- The Gateway at startup and `doctor` warn while claiming is on and an enabled app still has no owner.

**Three-level `config`**
- The editor now goes category → section → settings. The categories are:
  - Language
  - Model: provider and sign-in, context and model calls, messages during a reply
  - Chat apps and email: QQ, Feishu, Zulip, email
  - Tools and the web: tools, web search, browser, reading web pages, skills
  - Access and spending: access, spending limits
  - Companion
  - Gateway and updates: Gateway and Web UI, updates
- A category with a single section opens its settings directly.

**ChatGPT sign-in**
- There are two ways to sign in:
  - In a browser, with the local callback, or by pasting the address the last page ended on.
  - With a device code: open `auth.openai.com/codex/device` on any device (a phone works) and enter the code.

body:
**restarts-api.** No schema change.

Follow-up to #1098, which merged while Farol's two findings on it (one issue) were open.

- **The bug:** `updateForumSettings` read the forum's settings under `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, but before a forum's first save there is no settings row to lock. Two first saves racing (on, then off) both read the defaults. The second save's audit callback compared its result with that stale value and wrote nothing, so the setting ended up off with no audit row for the change back.
- **The fix:** a per-forum transaction advisory lock, taken before the read, serialises saves whether or not a row exists.
- **Test:** eight rounds of racing first saves in `api/forums.test.ts`. In each round, replaying the audit trail from the defaults must land on the stored value. Without the lock the test fails; with it the file passes (27 tests). `tsc` and eslint are clean.

author: ahlag
body:
Closes #9666

## Problem

The code analyzer treats mixed Japanese/Chinese and Latin identifiers as a single token, so their parts can't be searched. Full-width digits and half-width katakana aren't normalized either.

Tokens with `analyzer="code"`, `split_identifiers=True`:

| Input | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `getユーザー` | `getユーザー` | `getユーザー`, `get`, `ユーザー` |
| `ユーザーget` | `ユーザーget` | `ユーザーget`, `ユーザー`, `get` |
| `用户Name` | `用户name` | `用户name`, `用户`, `name` |
| `ｕｔｆ８` | `utf8` | `utf8`, `utf`, `8` |
| `ﾕｰｻﾞｰ` | `ﾕｰｻﾞｰ` | `ユーザー` |

Long Japanese/Chinese tokens are also dropped too early, because `max_token_length` counts UTF-8 bytes: a 14-character Japanese token is 42 bytes and is removed at the default limit of 40.

## What changed

**Word boundaries** (`lance-tokenizer/src/word_delimiter_filter.rs`)
- A switch between a caseless letter (kana, kanji, hanzi) and a cased letter is a boundary, in either order.
- The digit boundary uses `char::is_numeric` instead of `is_ascii_digit`, so full-width and Arabic-Indic digits split like ASCII digits.

**Folding** (`lance-tokenizer/src/ascii_folding_filter.rs`)
- `AsciiFoldingFilter` applies NFKC before folding, so compatibility forms with no ASCII equivalent (e.g. half-width katakana) normalize to their canonical form.
- Normalization still runs after splitting. Normalizing before the word-delimiter stage, as suggested in the issue, would change token byte lengths, and sub-token offsets are computed from byte positions in the original text. Splitting on Unicode digits gives the same result for `ｕｔｆ８` without touching offsets.

**Token length** (`lance-tokenizer/src/remove_long.rs`)
- `RemoveLongFilter` compares the character count rather than the byte length. The strict `<` comparison is unchanged (see #9668).

Not included: ICU word segmentation for Japanese/Chinese runs inside the code analyzer, which needs a design decision.

## Compatibility

The folding and length changes apply to every analyzer that uses `ascii_folding` or `max_token_length`, not only the code analyzer. Existing indexes containing CJK text, non-ASCII digits, or half-width katakana produce different tokens after a rebuild, and queries against an index built before this change may tokenize differently from the indexed text until it is rebuilt.

## Tests

New tests: `test_word_delimiter_cjk_latin_boundaries`, `test_word_delimiter_non_ascii_digits`, `test_ascii_folding_halfwidth_katakana`, `test_remove_long_counts_chars_not_bytes`, and `test_build_code_tokenizer_splits_cjk_and_non_ascii_digits` (the full code-analyzer pipeline, which checks the table above).

```
cargo test -p lance-tokenizer                      # 21 passed
cargo test -p lance-index --lib scalar::inverted   # 913 passed
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy -p lance-tokenizer -p lance-index --tests --benches --no-deps -- -D warnings
```

`cargo clippy --all` was not run locally. Clippy on the two changed crates is clean.

author: businessboard30-ship-it
body:
## The outage
After #267 merged (06:19), every bot process on Railway (worker and clone service) fails at startup:

```
database.py _create_tables -> conn.execute(privacy_migration.read_text())  ->  TimeoutError
[startup] bot.start() failed (attempt 1/2/...) - backing off
```
`051_privacy_retention.sql` runs three table-wide UPDATEs, a DELETE and a CREATE INDEX on `flood_events`, `scam_shield_hits` and `ai_command_log` in ONE statement during the startup DDL pass. On the real (large) tables it exceeds the timeout, rolls back, and the next restart tries the whole thing again, with every process doing it at the same time and waiting on each other's row locks. The bots never get past `db.init()`.

## The fix
- `database.py`: the 051 step is no longer run at startup. `SCHEMA_VERSION` 96 -> 97 (the version is stuck at 95 in the database because the pass never completes, so the next start runs the DDL pass once, without 051, and finishes).
- `modules/data_retention.py`: the same clean-up now runs in the background in **batches of 2,000 rows** (`LIMIT $1 ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, `SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'`, at most 25 batches per run), so it can never block a start and several bots can run it at once. It covers: old flood message text, scam-hit snippets, AI command arguments, and the old-row deletes (flood > 10 min, AI log > 90 d, scam hits > 180 d). The daily job on the main bot carries on until everything is blank. Failures are logged, never raised.
- Deleted `database/migrations/051_privacy_retention.sql` (the new batches do its work; the unused index it created is dropped from the plan).
- Tests: schema guard re-pinned to 97; privacy tests now check the startup step is gone and the batch SQL is bounded and lock-safe; new tests for batching (stops at a short batch, caps one run, never raises). 47 related tests pass.

## After merging
Railway redeploys by itself. Watch the worker and clone service logs for `schema_version ... running full DDL pass` followed by `Logged in as ...`, then `[retention] daily purge: {...}` on the main bot.

Note: message text that is already stored stays until the batches reach it (minutes to hours depending on size), not instantly at startup.

author: warhammer4000
body: ## Summary Executor hardening for installer tasks (#134, contract §4 and §7). It doesn't depend on the other installer issues. ### 1. `retry_on_failure` (contract §4) `GetRetryableTasks` and `ResetOldFailedTasks` skip failed tasks whose stored payload has `"retry_on_failure": false`: ```sql (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_type(payload, '$.retry_on_failure') END) IS NOT 'false' ``` This is done in SQL instead of setting `attempt_count`, so it also covers tasks already stored. A missing key, `true`, the string `"false"`, or a malformed payload all keep today's behaviour. The `CASE` guard is there because `json_type` errors on malformed JSON. ### 2. Notes capped at 64 KiB - `outputBuffer` keeps the first 8 KiB plus a 56 KiB ring buffer for the tail, and counts the bytes dropped in between. Scripts now write into it (`runBounded`) instead of using `CombinedOutput()`, so memory stays bounded however much a script prints. - `capNote` applies the same cap in one place, right before `ReportTaskStatus`. It covers native handlers and the `(Error: …)` suffix as well. The separator is `\n…[truncated N bytes]…\n`. - If a `SENTINEL_REBOOT_REQUIRED` line appeared anywhere in the stream, it's appended when truncation cut it. That includes a marker in the dropped middle or one split across writes. - After truncation, the note is repaired to valid UTF-8. ### 3. Env through sudo (implemented here, as the issue asks, so #137 can use it) - `executeLocalScript(ctx, script, payload, env)` on all three OSes sets `cmd.Env = os.Environ() + env`. - On Linux under `sudo -S`, the variables go through `env(1)`: `sudo -S /usr/bin/env K=V … bash script payload`. This is needed because sudo's `env_reset` drops them. `linuxScriptCommand` is split out so this can be tested. - No caller passes env yet; #137 will. ### Also `internal/artifact`: added a `#nosec G302` explaining the intended 0700 on the artifacts dir. The non-required `gosec` check flagged it on #152 after that PR merged. ## Test plan - [x] Store: `retry_on_failure` false → not returned or reset. true, missing, `null` payload, string `"false"` and malformed JSON → retried. Also checked with a task stored through `StoreTasks`. - [x] `outputBuffer`: small output unchanged; exactly 64 KiB unchanged; single 5 MB write; many 7-byte writes; a size × chunk grid around the 8 KiB and 64 KiB boundaries; 8 concurrent writers. - [x] Reboot marker: kept from the dropped middle, including when split across writes or written one byte at a time; not duplicated when already in the tail; a partial marker isn't reported. - [x] `executeTask`: a 5 MB note with a marker in the middle is reported and stored at ≤ 64 KiB, with its tail, the error suffix and the marker. - [x] Linux: sudo args are `-S env K=V … bash script payload`; the no-sudo path sets `cmd.Env`; a real run with `env -i` (scrubbed like `env_reset`) shows the script sees the variables. - [x] `go test ./...` passes on Windows except the known environmental `TestConfigLoadDefaultPath`. The task, store and binpath tests pass on Linux (WSL). Also ran `-race` on the task, store and artifact packages, `make check-no-cgo`, `make verify-cross`, golangci-lint v2.12.2 on all 3 OSes, and gosec for both Windows and Linux (0 issues). Fixes #139 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ---

author: ritambiswas404
body:
Promotes the approved board shake scatter-and-fade from /experiment-live to the landing page. Three files in `components/home`: `useHeroDirector.ts`, `HeroStage.tsx`, `useTactile.ts`.

**Problem:** scattered objects flew out at full opacity and were sliced by the page's side clipping (or removed while still on screen).

**Fix:** each object fades by its own path. `clipRect()` measures what really clips (viewport minus scrollbar, narrowed by clipping ancestors). The fade is timed from the object's visible (alpha) bounds to finish when they are half cut by the edge it heads for (0.42 s, exponential ease-in; paths that never reach an edge fade by the end of the flight). Objects starting very near an edge get a softened start of their own flight; all others keep the original curve. Opacity only decreases during a burst; restored if aborted; mostly faded objects are not hoverable/grabbable.

**Unchanged:** shake trigger, scatter directions/spin/distance, restock, drag-and-return, reduced-motion path.

**Checks:** tsc, eslint (clean on the 3 files), `next build --webpack`. Behaviour verified by the owner on /experiment-live; measured there at 1440x900, 2560x1080, 1100x680 and 375 mobile (fade 200-400 ms, no opacity increases, no leftover objects).

## Intent

Implement step 7’s small MLOps lifecycle: promotion, shadow evaluation and rollback. Preserve the review guard and locked test set, validate the changes, and push to main. The user’s project is an honest Newfoundland and Labrador C-CORE AI Engineer portfolio. Implement a local research lifecycle with explicit manual promotion, paired validation-only inference, hash-bound package/dataset/code/configuration/reference provenance, existing independent complete-area review and operating objective gates, coverage and resource checks, and atomic revisioned rollback with operator history. Production pipeline configuration, MLflow aliases and operational alerts must remain unchanged; cloud deployment and automatic retraining are outside this small lifecycle. Current unreviewed NL evidence must refuse promotion. Successful promotion and rollback are tested using genuinely synthetic fixtures and clearly invented reviewer declarations. Real existing-reference-versus-itself shadow replay processed six VV/VH validation areas and retained four unsupported HH/HV areas, had identical predictions and zero failures, and refused actual promotion; it demonstrates software behavior rather than model improvement. Preserve quarantine, original annotation/curation bytes and hashes, and all locked-test assignments and pixels. In isolated validation worktrees, use only public committed metadata and synthetic fixtures; never copy, link or indirectly read original private data, weights or imagery from E:/TritonEye. Black on Windows must use --workers 1. All current commits must be preserved. The user explicitly authorizes merging the validated PR to main after CI passes.

## What Changed

- Add `agents/model_lifecycle.py`, a SQLite-journaled CLI for registering content-addressed model packages, setting an unvalidated reference, promoting a candidate after rechecking integrity/review/comparison, and rolling back to a previously recorded model+threshold with revision-guarded, logged decisions.
- Add `agents/model_shadow.py`, which runs paired reference-vs-candidate inference over the complete validation area selection (excluding training/locked-test areas), records predictions, hashes, coverage/resource metrics, and recomputes metrics only from reviewed labels via the existing `validation_labels` guard.

- Add `tests/unit/test_model_lifecycle.py` covering registration, shadow processing, promotion, rollback, and refusal paths using synthetic fixtures and invented reviewer declarations.
